response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country AS country, AVG(cs.wins) AS a FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country), o AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM c), g AS (SELECT c.country, c.a FROM c, o WHERE c.a > o.m), gm AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.a) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(g.a - o.m) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(g.a - gm.m) AS mean_excess_over_group FROM g, o, gm WHERE g.a > gm.m
